name: envrampart: .env Validator & Secret Scanner CLI
price_note: one-time; team license, up to 10 developers
summary: A zero-dependency CLI that checks your `.env` files against a simple schema, keeps `.env.example` and config docs in sync, and catches real secrets before they get committed.
compatibility: Any stack that uses .env files (Node, Go, Rails, Django, Laravel, Docker Compose)
license_note: Unlimited personal, commercial, and client projects. You may vendor it into your repos and container images. You may not resell or republish the tool itself. One purchase covers up to 10 developers.
